metadata.anchor: Same ground and central-front anchor as the building. Main deck rear edge meets Z=0, with native approach aprons filling the source-plan front setbacks; water faces -Z.
adaptations: 306 x18 m waterfront strip plus4896 square metres of approach aprons, regularly spaced piers and one central two-metre stair are game placement choices, not a measured historic site plan.
Only original native shoreline recipe parts are used; no stretch and no duplicated private recipe.
Water, bulk land fill, historical crowds/boats and collision/traversal are omitted.
